editorial:
Imagine starting your journey with a heartbreaking loss that fuels a lifelong fire for justice. You get to follow Kapil, a man who loses his brother to drugs and decides the only way to fight back is to become the law himself. After working his way up to a C.I.D. Inspector, he seems to have it all under control until a close friend is murdered right before his eyes. The vibe here is pure 80s energy, mixing gritty city streets with the sunny but dangerous backdrop of Goa. You will feel his frustration when the system fails him, pushing him to take matters into his own hands.

What really works here is the high energy and the emotional stakes. The action scenes are classic for the era, and the pacing keeps you moving toward that big showdown. While some of the plot points feel a bit predictable, the passion in the acting makes it work. If you love old-school revenge stories, you should definitely check this out. It is best enjoyed streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you can find it, or you might want to grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep that retro style in your physical collection forever.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a massive confrontation in Goa where Kapil finally tracks down the drug lords responsible for his friend's death. After a series of intense fights and chases, Kapil uses his police training and raw anger to take down the villains. He clears the drug ring and gets the revenge he wanted. In the end, justice is served, and he finds peace knowing he protected others from the same pain he felt.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s Bollywood action and revenge plots.
